query: How did JPMorgan's investment banking fees trend in Q3 and what was the overall press sentiment?

earnings.notes: Net interest income of $23.5B exceeded guidance midpoint of $23B. Investment banking fees up 31% YoY. CEO Dimon warned of geopolitical and credit risks.
Q2 included $7.9B gain from Visa share exchange. Excluding one-time items, underlying revenue was $42.4B.

results.headline: JPMorgan Q3 Net Income Rises 35% on Higher Interest Income
results.body: JPMorgan Chase reported Q3 2024 net income of $12.9 billion, up 35% from a year earlier, driven by rising net interest income and strong investment banking fees. Revenue of $43.3 billion beat analyst expectations of $41.8 billion. CEO Jamie Dimon warned of geopolitical risks and potential credit deterioration ahead.

results.headline: JPMorgan Raises Full-Year Net Interest Income Guidance to $92.5B
results.body: JPMorgan Chase raised its full-year net interest income guidance to approximately $92.5 billion, up from its prior guidance of $91 billion. The revision reflects higher-for-longer interest rates and strong loan growth. Analysts viewed the revision positively as it signals confidence in the bank's core earnings power.

answer:
In Q3, JPMorgan's investment banking fees were $3.49 billion, which beat the estimated amount of $3.3 billion. The overall press sentiment was positive as indicated by articles such as "JPMorgan's Q3 Investment Banking Fees Beat Estimates" from Bloomberg and "Positive Sentiment as JPMorgan's Q3 Investment Banking Fees Exceeded Expectations" from Financial Times. These articles highlight that the investment banking fees exceeded expectations, contributing positively to the overall performance of the company.
